messages:
Maya Chen: Heads-up — ran a routine compliance sampling and found ~12 role_mapping change events with a missing "modified_by" / provenance field in the audit store. Sample below, all from the same 30m window.

Jordan Patel: Where are you seeing this? which sink and which index/prefix? @auditor_bot

Maya Chen: s3://redwood-audit-prod/events/2026/03/15/*.json processed by audit-processor v2.1.2. Events have event_type=role_mapping_update and modified_by=null for several records.

Sam Kline: Can you paste one sample event (redact PII)?

Maya Chen: ```json
{
  "event_type": "role_mapping_update",
  "role_id": "data-analyst",
  "target_principal": "svc-data-sync",
  "modified_by": null,
  "timestamp": "2026-03-15T14:22:07Z",
  "source": "perm-sync-service",
  "request_id": "req-abc123-78",
  "details": {"change":"remove_user_from_role"}
}
```

Jordan Patel: perm-sync-service — that's the scheduled LDAP->internal reconciler. It sometimes runs in a headless mode. Could be a fallback path where actor enrichment fails and we write a minimal event.

Kevin Ortiz: I recall a change in perm-sync on 2026-03-15 (deploy d-774). We switched to async enrichment and added a fallback write path. Logs might show a WARN when enrichment fails. I'll check deploy notes.

Maya Chen: I grepped the worker logs and found this pattern:
```
perm-sync/worker[pid]: WARN failed to enrich actor info for request=req-abc123-78, writing minimal audit event
```

auditor_bot: Incident created: SEC-2026-042 — "Missing provenance on role_mapping audit events". Initial severity P2. Link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/SEC-2026-042

Sam Kline: Do we know if any of these correspond to manual grants/removals (human action)? That's a compliance red flag if so.

Maya Chen: From initial correlation these were all automated reconciler-run changes (weekly group sync). No manual sessions found, but compliance requires that the audit event indicate the acting principal (service account) for provenance.

Jordan Patel: Proposed plan:
1) enumerate full time window and surface all events with modified_by IS NULL
2) correlate by request_id to perm-sync logs to see if we can reconstruct actor info
3) if reconstructable, backfill audit store with enriched actor and mark as "backfilled"
4) patch perm-sync to always write service_principal when user is absent and add metric null_actor_count
5) alerting + compliance report + signoff

Kevin Ortiz: I'll prepare a patch to ensure we set modified_by = "svc:perm-sync" in the audit payload when enrichment is unavailable, and attach request_id to logs for correlation. Will push a canary to staging in ~15m.

Maya Chen: SQL we can run to find events:
```
SELECT * FROM audit_events
WHERE event_type = 'role_mapping_update'
  AND modified_by IS NULL
  AND timestamp >= '2026-03-15T14:00:00Z'
  AND timestamp <  '2026-03-15T15:00:00Z';
```

Maya Chen: And a join to backfill candidate actor using perm-sync logs (if request_id present):
```
-- pseudo-SQL: merge backfill
WITH candidates AS (
  SELECT a.id AS audit_id, p.actor AS actor
  FROM audit_events a
  JOIN perm_sync_logs p ON a.request_id = p.request_id
  WHERE a.modified_by IS NULL
)
UPDATE audit_events SET modified_by = c.actor, note = 'backfilled from perm-sync logs' FROM candidates c WHERE audit_events.id = c.audit_id;
```

Sam Kline: If backfill can't recover full provenance we need a compliance write-up explaining the system action and timeline (and that we remedied the storage semantics). I'll draft that if needed.

Jordan Patel: I'll own the enumeration + initial backfill attempt. @Kevin Ortiz please ping here when staging canary is up so I can re-run an ingestion sample.

Kevin Ortiz: Canary deployed to staging (perm-sync v3.0.1-canary). Added metric perm_sync.null_actor_count and request_id logging. Rolling to prod in next 1h after smoke tests.

Maya Chen: Please also add an automatic alert if null_actor_count > 0 for >5m in production; compliance wants immediate detection.

auditor_bot: SEC-2026-042 severity updated to P1 — compliance requests timeline and inventory.

Jordan Patel: Moving to incidents channel for triage and I'll kick off a short remediation timeline. Will capture root cause as deploy fallback path in the post-incident notes if confirmed.

Kevin Ortiz: I'll follow up with a PR link and the deploy window. Thanks all.

Maya Chen: Thanks team — keep updates here and in incidents. :thumbsup:
